<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BottlingInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/bottling-machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionStart" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterData</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineData" name="Enter machine type and serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterData</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterDataToQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions and input values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterDataToQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_QuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButton" name="Press inspection button">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_QuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtonToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect values from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtonToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToShow</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ShowValues" name="Show collected values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToShow</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShowToResultGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultSplit" name="Additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShowToResultGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions and input values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultMerge" name="Inspection results consolidated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterData" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionStart" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterDataToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineData" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToPressButton" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtonToCollect" sourceRef="Task_PressButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToShow" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_ShowValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowToResultGateway" sourceRef="Task_ShowValues" targetRef="Gateway_ResultSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsNeeded" name="Yes, results require additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultSplit" targetRef="Task_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
